CREATE TABLE v2_autopilot_exec_attempts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	operation_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	image_budget_state VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_image_outputs INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	receipt JSON, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id, project_id) REFERENCES v2_autopilot_runs (id, project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (run_id, operation_key), 
	UNIQUE (project_id, job_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_v2_autopilot_exec_attempts_state CHECK (state IN ('reserved','queued','spawn_intent','running','validating','outcome_unknown','cancel_requested','completed','failed','settled')), 
	CHECK (domain IN ('text','image')), 
	CHECK (image_budget_state IN ('none','reserved','consumed','released')), 
	CHECK ((domain = 'text' AND image_budget_state = 'none' AND reserved_image_outputs = 0) OR (domain = 'image' AND image_budget_state != 'none' AND reserved_image_outputs BETWEEN 1 AND 4))
)

	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES v2_managed_assets (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(approval_id) REFERENCES v2_approval_decisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE v2_video_jobs (
